senses.gloss: m. (frumentarius) military purveyor, commissary, imperial agent (v. Sm. Ant. s. v. Frumentarius). Y’lamd. to Deut. III, 23 sq., quot. in Ar. משה היה פַּלְמַנְטָרוֹ וכ׳ Moses was the Lord’s special agent (v.
units: <cite ref="Numbers 12:7">Num. XII, 7</cite>). Yalk. Lam. 1001 <he>פלמנסר של מלך</he> (corr. acc.)—Pl. <he>פַּלְמַנְטָרִין</he>.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 1:4:3">Y. Ber. I, 3ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>למלך ששלח שני פ׳ וכ׳</he> Ar. a. ed. Lehm. (ed. <cite ref="Q01081"><he>פלמטרין</he></cite>, corr. acc.) like a king who sent out two frumentarii (negotiators); with regard to one he wrote, give him no credit unless he shows my signature and seal &c.; <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:2:7">Cant. R. to I, 2</cite>; Y. Ab. Zar. II, 41ᶜ bot. <cite ref="O00714"><he>סימנטירין</he></cite> (corr. acc.). Tanḥ. B’midb. 26 [read:] <he>אף אני מקרבן ועושם פ׳ שלי וכ׳</he> I, too, shall bring them near, and make them my special agents, and entrust my house and my sanctity to none but them; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 695">Yalk. Num. 695</cite> <cite ref="Q01025"><he>פלטנטירין</he></cite> (corr. acc.); v. <cite ref="Q01030"><he>פַּלְטֵרִין</he></cite>.—[<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 2:6:2">Y. Taan. II, 65ᵈ</cite>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Beitzah 1:7:4">Y. Bets. I, 60ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>פלמנטרין</he>, v. <cite ref="Q00979"><he>פְּלוּמַטְרִין</he></cite>.]
